title: Bồ Đào Nha bị Congo cầm hòa, Ronaldo nhạt nhòa ngày ra quân

scenes.subjectHint: Hook — Ronaldo thất vọng, BĐN hòa Congo 1-1 ngày mở màn World Cup

He wears the iconic red-and-green Portugal home kit with the Portuguese Football Federation crest clearly visible on the chest and the captain's armband. Background: a moody dark crimson Portugal graphic backdrop with a huge stylized Portugal crest floating faintly behind him as a watermark, cold downward light rays creating a somber atmosphere, a faint stylized DR Congo flag color band (blue and red with a yellow star) along the lower edge as a graphic accent hinting at the surprise opponent. Vibrant but moody saturated red-and-green palette, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday editorial poster. The Portugal crest visible on the jersey, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
